subject: Trial addendum: 30-day extension and seat pricing options
messages:
From: Claire Fox <cfox@mediq.dev>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trial addendum request — 30d extension & seat split

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Mediq is close to a decision, but we need a little more runway to complete clinical integration tests. Our original POC window ends May 15. Two asks:

- Can you extend the POC by 30 days? We can convert to a paid extension if needed, but would appreciate a short discount.
- We expect to invite 3 more clinicians during the extension (so +5 seats total). If we exceed token consumption forecasts, what’s the incremental price and is there a short-term cap you can help us set?

Ideally we’d like to avoid a full procurement cycle for a short extension — any flexibility on term-based pricing or a small pilot addendum would help.

Attaching our updated usage estimate. Happy to hop on a quick call today.

Cheers,
Claire
Claire Fox
Head of Integrations, Mediq Health

Attachment: Mediq-usage-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Fox <cfox@mediq.dev>, Samir Patel <samir@mediq.dev>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial addendum request — 30d extension & seat split

Hi Claire — thank you, and glad the demo was useful. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate an extension and offer two straightforward paths depending on how you want to proceed.

Option A — Time-bound evaluation (no upfront payment):
- 30-day free extension for the existing environment.
- Limited to the same performance tier and an additional 2 seats (max 5).
- Token cap: we can set a soft cap at 2.5M tokens for the month; overages will be blocked and we’ll notify you.

Option B — Paid short extension (recommended if you expect higher consumption):
- 30 days; billable at our short-term pilot rate with a 15% one-time discount on token charges and per-seat fees.
- We can lift the soft cap and set an overage rate at $0.012/token after cap.
- We’ll credit unused portion of the original pilot credit against the extension invoice.

If you need deeper discounts (20%+), I’ll need approval from revenue ops — pinging Marcus to confirm the band we can approve without legal sign-off.

Next steps: if you want Option B I’ll prepare a pilot addendum and a DocuSign envelope. If Option A works, I can enable the extension today and add the two clinician accounts.

On logistics: I’ve attached our latest ratecard for short pilots and the POC addendum template.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.inference
Attachment: Redwood-POC-Ratecard-v1.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Trial addendum request — internal approval for pilot discount?

Marcus/Karthik — forwarding Mediq’s request. They want a 30d extension and +2 seats (5 seats total). Estimated incremental tokens for the month are ~2–3M per their attached sheet. My proposed commercials: 30d paid extension at our short-pilot rate with a 20% discount (midpoint between the standard 15% and their ask for a bigger concession). I can accept 20% under ARR motion but need quick sign-off for the finance impact and whether we can pre-authorize token overage cap waivers.

Why I think 20% is OK:
- Mediq is close to clinical sign-off and is likely to convert to a Dedicated contract if tests pass.
- This extension avoids a procurement restart (high friction) and preserves momentum.

Impact estimate: at 2.5M tokens at $0.015/token list = $37,500 gross; 20% discount saves them $7,500 while leaving ~$30k ARR for a single month pilot — acceptable if it accelerates conversion.

Can you confirm:
- Marcus: approve up to 20% discount for short pilots and can you authorize a one-time marketing credit of $2,000 if we need to sweeten?
- Karthik: can finance create an invoice flow that applies the remaining pilot credit to the extension?

Thanks — I’ll hold on sending DocuSign until I hear back.

—
Jasmine

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.inference>
To: Claire Fox <cfox@mediq.dev>, Samir Patel <samir@mediq.dev>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial addendum request — 30d extension & seat split (agreement and next steps)

Hi Claire & Samir — quick update and confirmation:

Thanks for the detailed usage estimate — we’ll move forward with a paid 30-day extension per Option B with the following terms:
- Extension window: May 15 — Jun 14, 2026
- Seats: 5 active clinician seats (adds 2 to the POC)
- Token cap: soft cap at 3,000,000 tokens; overages billed at $0.012/token
- Commercials: short-pilot rate with a 20% one-time discount applied to the extension invoice
- Marketing credit: Redwood will apply a $2,000 marketing/promotional credit if you need help with clinician onboarding materials

I’ve attached the pilot addendum and the invoice summary. Please review and e-sign via the DocuSign link below; we’ll provision the extra seats and lift the cap as soon as the agreement is countersigned.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/12345abcdef
Attachments: Redwood-POC-Ratecard-v1.pdf, Mediq-usage-estimate.xlsx

Proposed next step: 30-minute handoff call (engineering + clinical lead) to schedule integration smoke tests — I’m available Wed/Thu mornings PT.

If this all looks good I’ll send the DocuSign now.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
